note: Q is one dark calculator with orange keys and a 4x5 grid made four times, differing only in grey and orange tints. P and R each have one 7-segment LCD (P1, R1/R3 are near-twins in R) plus light and dark flat takes, with some key-layout changes (wide 0, wide = row, ± position); R has two near-duplicate LCD skeuomorphs and P has two similar cream/orange flat ones, so they come out about equal.
